info.name: Tuya Device Management Devices API
info.description:
The Tuya Device Management API provides endpoints for querying, controlling, and managing IoT devices registered to a Tuya cloud project. Capabilities include device information retrieval, device control, factory reset, device renaming, sub-device listing, operation log queries, and user-device association management.

Contact Support:
 Name: Tuya Developer Support
 Email: developer@tuya.com
